highlights: If a frost email has already gone out and a newer forecast moves the cold to an earlier night, a new frost email now names the earlier night, once; a night that moves later sends nothing new
Clear-and-calm frost warnings now check the sky on the night the cold actually arrives and are titled Frost watch, and a forecast-service outage no longer stops the afternoon frost check
On nights the frost line warns about tonight, the forecast card and the weather line show the same low, so Today no longer shows two different lows for one night
Rain from the weather station is no longer logged on plantings you've marked Ended or Failed, or on plants in a deleted or archived container; Dormant plantings still get it
